title: Unify bundled font behavior
description: Document a redistributable bundled font set and make shared metrics and bytes the sole typography source for rich scene layout, SVG preview, and PDF output.
acceptanceCriteria: Every bundled font file, supported weight/style, source, and redistribution license is documented
Scene layout, SVG preview, and PDF rendering resolve the same font identity and metrics
Unsupported font, weight, style, or glyph requests return structured diagnostics
No system-font fallback can silently alter printable geometry
A mixed-text fixture has matching normalized positions in preview and parsed PDF

steps.details: Review TASK-29 font resources and licenses, then define the minimal rich-content font registry without adding a second metrics source.
Route scene layout, preview registration, and PDF embedding through one application-owned font identity, metrics, glyph-coverage, and bytes contract.
Return node-specific diagnostics for unavailable family, style, weight, or glyphs instead of allowing browser or PDF fallbacks.
Render one mixed rich-text fixture through SVG and PDF adapters and compare normalized text positions and selected font resources.

technicalNotes: Keep this increment under ten minutes by reusing the TASK-29 font set and adding only rich-content registry coverage.
Font parity is software evidence and does not prove physical printed scale or placement.
